content.title: Chapter 70 - PERSONNEL RULES — Sec. 70-66. - Assignment pay.

faqs.a:
Regular and probationary non-exempt employees assigned to be on call 24-hours per
               day for a continuous, consecutive and ongoing basis of 27 weeks or more and required
               to respond to an emergency situation will be paid assignment pay in accordance with
               applicable federal and state laws and a policy established by the city manager.
(
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16-2023;
Ord. No. 4890
, § 8, 2-10-2025)
